notes: System prompts are rendered from these parts so that order B reverses the classes everywhere (task sentence, definitions, answer options) while each definition stays with its class. The user message is the stimulus text alone.
intro_template: You code {domain} for a conflict-event dataset. Read the event description and decide whether the event is {first_phrase} or {second_phrase}.

definitions.Protest: Protest: a public demonstration in which participants remain nonviolent, including demonstrations that face intervention or violence from others.
definitions.Riot: Riot: a demonstration in which participants engage in violence or destruction, such as attacking people or damaging property.

definitions.Battle: Battle: a violent clash between organized armed groups that are capable of harming each other.
definitions.Violence against civilians: Violence against civilians: an organized armed group deliberately attacks unarmed civilians who cannot defend themselves.
